elements.text:
Fifty one films
from nineteen coasts

Old Customs House
and the Pier Cinema

Four small things I do
on my days off.
Ten minutes of nothing in particular. A window, a glass of water, the light moving across the floor.
At a table, with a plate that is not a keyboard tray. Chew. Notice the salt.
Save this for later and send it to someone who keeps a very full calendar.
Dinner and music to follow. Kindly reply by 1 May.

Six kilometres, easy pace, coffee after.
Bring a light layer, leave the watch at home.

Stockholm to Narvik
1 400 km, 19 hours a day

Lighting design for rooms
that change through the day
A one day symposium on streets, benches and the speed of walking.

12 September 2026
City Library, Hall B
Free, seats limited
